basis: Approved independent BRIEF/API/reference propositions and reference PNGs, both actual production component sources, original common corpora plus frozen state binding and pixel tools. No candidate served as the other candidate reference.
contact_sheet_method: Viewport crops from the original PNGs were placed using observed native scroll geometry. Full original hashes and indices are retained. Every page of all 25 contact sheets was visually inspected; original PNG spot checks additionally verified narrow dossier text and RTL submitted footer.

records.inspection: All seven state strips were inspected, including caller replacement, unavailable a/c reasons, native selected/enabled state and disclosure labels, a dossier in expanded state, b selection and unchanged summary after submission. Baseline/expanded/submitted were judged separately. Both sources use native disabled and selected controls; actual bridges call the capsule component and map its callbacks without a local business reducer. Continuous-rail and typography-size details are not certified by these two visual atoms.
scope_limits: Qualitative atoms establish only wrapping and overlap, not complete design equivalence.
Native iOS title weight remains unsupported; no visual substitution.
Narrow iOS replaced/reselected/submitted notice fill remains U when no fully visible eligible target frame exists.

contradictory_or_insufficient_evidence.native_coverage: Interval union 0..1640 against height 1646. Bottom sentinel reported visible, but this does not satisfy the frozen complete-content rule. Visible footer appears whole; that cannot override missing full coverage.
contradictory_or_insufficient_evidence.selected_effect: submitted wrapping and overlap both null; target-only reselected visual cells are not selected.

failure_cause_assessment: No supported typed-native, rendered-pixel or qualitative failures were found. Attributions are empty, rather than inventing a cause for unknown evidence.
consensus: One independent reviewer only. Any later AI agreement is consensus, not human gold.
